SOURCE: one table row, read twice (columns: Name of state | Hanzi | Family | Present location | Title | Start and end year | Conqueror). Called Hui (鄶) in the zheng dossier (ea-01-d), which carries the 769 gain with the Zhengzhou 25 km disc; the list spells it Kuai. The start year is a bridge. The disc and the capital dot are the researcher's reading of the county or town named in the row (coordinates, since the gazetteer lacks most of these places). AREA: none. No rulers, no capitals, no wars on the list.
